scope: Completed local capacity runs only; different request counts are not equivalent loads

database_evidence.interpretation: HTTP stream interval counts are not token counts. No intervals does not prove no engine computation. No response pickle is loaded.

batch_evidence.note: Batch audit has no timestamps; this measures ordering, not stall duration. Server warmup may be included.

lifecycle_evidence.note: File-order audit of removed IDs; no abort receipt is inconclusive about cancellation. Reclaimed blocks do not make timed-out requests successful.
